content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate observed on gateway cluster eu-west-1 (svc: redwood-gateway). Error rate spike starting 2026-03-15T14:40Z. Current 5xx rate: 18% (baseline 0.5%). Auto-escalation: paging on-call. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/gateway-errors
alex.k: seeing the alert, joining. Are we seeing increased latency upstream or backend timeouts?
priya.s: logs show a lot of 502s coming from the model-bridge pool (bridge-eu-west-1). I'm seeing connection resets to model-bridge replicas and repeated upstream timeouts.
cassie: confirming, Sentry shows spike in "upstream_timeout" and "connection_reset" for bridge-proxy. Top traces point to long tail at token generation handoff.
mike.t: copying runbook section 4 (gateway partial outage) -> https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-partial-outage. First mitigations: scale gateway pods, enable fallback routing to eu-north, and throttle long-running requests.
alex.k: running quick health checks. `curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/engines/text/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` --> returns 502 with body: `{"error":"upstream timeout"}`.
priya.s: `kubectl get pods -n gateway -l region=eu-west -o wide` -> many pods in CrashLoopBackOff for bridge-proxy-cc. Suspect a memory leak or sudden load.
cassie: memory graphs show a sharp increase in mem use for bridge-proxy from 14:30Z. Could be a bad model variant or a customer traffic spike. Pulling top request IDs.
alex.k: paging infra team to increase gateway replicas and add temporary route shift. @irene.n are you available for handoff if we need cross-region shift?
irene.n: here, 10 min to spin up. If we shift traffic, we'll need to ensure KV cache warmup and prefer eu-north models that are compatible.
priya.s: suggestion: enable routing policy to prefer eu-north for new requests and keep existing connections on eu-west until drained. This avoids mid-request failures.
mike.t: I'm going to bump gateway deployment to 6->12 replicas and tilt traffic. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=12 -n gateway` (doing now).
deploy-bot: deploy/gateway scaled from 6 to 12 replicas by mike.t at 2026-03-15T14:47:30Z.
cassie: scaling didn't fully mitigate — bridge-proxy pods still showing high error rate. The bridge layer seems overloaded; adding more gateway frontends increases request fanout and worsens the bridge saturation.
alex.k: ok revert scaling for gateway to avoid amplifying the issue. Instead we should route requests away from eu-west for non-low-latency SLAs. Plan: set routing weight eu-west=20%, eu-north=60%, us-east=20% for 15m, then reassess.
priya.s: updating routing config now. `curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/routing -d '{"weights":{"eu-west":20,"eu-north":60,"us-east":20}}'` -> 200 OK.
incident-bot: Routing update applied by priya.s. Start monitoring failover-health.
cassie: after weight change, 5xx rate in eu-west dropped to 6% and overall error rate is down to 3.5%. Latency for eu-north increased slightly but within SLO for most customers.
alex.k: good. we should also temporary blacklist the problematic bridge-proxy model-variant (mv-v2.3) in eu-west; it's showing repeated OOMs. Priya can you do that?
priya.s: blacklisting mv-v2.3 in eu-west for 30m. `controlplane models blacklist --region eu-west --model mv-v2.3 --duration 30m` -> success.
mike.t: noticing a handful of high-value customers still seeing errors because they are pinned to eu-west dedicated capacity. Cassie - can we check which customers are impacted?
cassie: pulling list... affected customers: AcmeAnalytics (dedicated-eu-west), NovaForms (shared), BrightHire (shared). Acme is on dedicated pool—need manual outreach.
alex.k: Cassie please loop in CS and AM for Acme and ask for a temporary routing override (we can route their dedicated IP to us-east if they approve).
cassie: pinging @customer-success. Message: "Heads-up: AcmeAnalytics seeing request failures; we can route to us-east as temporary mitigation — would you like us to initiate?"
customer-success-bot: CS notified for AcmeAnalytics.
irene.n: I'm taking on-call handoff at 15:00Z. Action items for next on-call: 1) monitor eu-west bridge-proxy memory graphs, 2) coordinate with infra for possible bridge pod restart/upgrade, 3) validate model variant blacklist, 4) confirm dedicated-customer routing overrides.
oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff noted: irene.n is now primary on-call for incidents at 2026-03-15T15:00Z.
priya.s: as a safer long-term step, we should enable circuit-breaker for bridge-proxy upstreams to limit concurrent token-generation sessions per replica. Adding configuration: `circuit_breaker: max_concurrent_requests: 150` to bridge-proxy config. Applying now.
priya.s: applied config; rolling restart of bridge-proxy to pick up settings. `kubectl rollout restart ds/bridge-proxy -n bridge`
deploy-bot: rollout restart triggered for ds/bridge-proxy by priya.s at 2026-03-15T15:04:12Z.
cassie: after circuit-breaker + routing, overall 5xx rate stabilized at 0.9% and tail latency trending down. Bridge-proxy OOMs dropped to normal.
alex.k: posting interim incident summary for status page: brief summary, affected regions/customers, mitigation (traffic reweight + model blacklist + circuit-breaker), and ongoing actions (postmortem, pre-prod validation of mv-v2.3). I'll draft and send after handoff.
irene.n: taking operations lead. I'll coordinate with infra to run memprof on bridge-proxy and schedule a canary re-intro of mv-v2.3 in a sandbox. Also will confirm whether dedicated-customer overrides were accepted.
cassie: CS confirmed Acme asked us to route to us-east temporarily — that's been configured. Their traffic appears healthy now.
priya.s: starting to run evaluation tests on mv-v2.3 in eu-west sandbox to reproduce OOM locally.
alex.k: thanks everyone. Key timestamps: alert 14:40Z, routing change 14:48Z, circuit-breaker applied 15:04Z, handoff to irene 15:00Z. We'll keep this thread as the incident record.
incident-bot: Incident status => partial degraded -> mitigated. Monitoring for 60m before resolving.
irene.n: I'll own the post-incident writeup and schedule a blameless postmortem. Please drop any relevant logs/links in this thread.
priya.s: adding links: Grafana errors panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/gateway-errors, Sentry: https://sentry.redwood.internal/organizations/redwood/issues/?query=upstream_timeout, Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-partial-outage
alex.k: recording follow-ups: (1) add model-variant pre-flight memory checks, (2) test routing weight automation, (3) instrument better per-customer impact flags in routing.
incident-bot: If error rate remains <1% after observation window, incident will be marked resolved automatically.
priya.s: will keep monitoring and will post final resolution status here.
